name: Phone app, whole flow
summary: A made-up ferry app as six working phone screens: choose a harbour, today's sailings, one sailing with a tickets sheet, pay, tickets and settings. Side by side on a desktop, one at a time (with push and back) on a phone. Loading, empty and error states.
anatomy: Board title → rail of phones: harbour list → large title + segmented + pull to refresh + next sailing + swipe rows + tab bar → back + crossing + facts + action bar + sheet with detents → pass + lines + pay → ticket + swipe rows → grouped settings
